changes.comment: Add `DAEMON_OPERATION_GROUPS_ENV_VAR` (`RUSHD_OPERATION_GROUPS`). On Linux, a daemon that records its operation process groups sets it in its own environment, so the processes that it starts carry it. After the daemon dies, a recorded group whose leader has exited is stopped only if one of its live members still carries that daemon's value. A later process that got the recorded ID and called `setsid()` is no longer stopped. A daemon from an earlier release sets no value, so the first reclaim after an upgrade leaves its groups whose leader has exited running.
